purpose: arc only: the realized bend between massive straights, anchored at A and D
status: candidate reference; no refutation record yet (see README.md)

quantity_families.<node>.<ux|uy|uz|rx|ry|rz>: displacement or rotation relative to the supports, global axes
quantity_families.<P1|P2|P3>.<i|j>.<Fx..Mz>: generalized force acting on the straight element at its end node, global axes: (K_e - w^2 M_e) u per mode, K_e u - M_e g in the rigid response
quantity_families.BEND1.elastic.<i|j>.<Fx..Mz>: K_arc u: the arc's elastic end action on the element, global axes
quantity_families.BEND1.lump_load.<i|j>.<Fx..Mz>: M_lump g: the half-arc lump's share of the inertia load, attributed to that end node, moments about the end node, global axes
quantity_families.BEND1.<i|j>.<Fx..Mz>: total arc end action on the element, elastic minus lump_load, global axes
quantity_families.BEND1.<i|j>.<Fx..Mz>_t: the same total in that end's U4a end-tangent frame (x the traversal tangent, y toward the centre, z = x cross y), node-on-element sign
quantity_families.J1.g.<N|Vy|Vz|T|My|Mz>: incremental work-conjugate connector force g = K_c B u in connector axes (axial, lateral y, lateral z, torsion, bending y, bending z); it excludes static pressure thrust, preload and reference load
quantity_families.J1.<i|j>.<Fx..Mz>: B^T g: incremental connector action on the connector at its end node, global axes
quantity_families.<R1|R2>.T: incremental rod axial force k b.u, tension positive (no pretension in this family)
quantity_families.<R1|R2>.<i|j>.<Fx..Mz>: b T: incremental rod action on the rod at its end node, global axes, moment about the node
quantity_families.<A|C|D|F>.<Fx..Mz>: reaction applied by the anchor to the piping, global axes: (K u - M g) at its DOFs
quantity_families.signed blocks: contributions_signed and rigid_response_signed are signed contributions, not peak responses
quantity_families.combined blocks: every *_combined value and every mutation entry is an unsigned combined magnitude
